trusted_basis.verification_owner: Aegis Implementation P31 package, with independent Control Review before P32
trusted_basis.test_cli_rule: Resolve the exact configured build directory and test target from CTest discovery; never treat an unmatched regex as PASS.

obligations.requirement: Freeze one-owner Document/View/Runtime composition, narrow Host ports, async capture lifetime, close order and platform execution context before production mutation.
obligations.oracle: ImplementationDesignPreflight records current Host -> Runtime -> owner flow, target owner/prepare/commit/publication/abort flow, exact affected files, and no unresolved semantic decisions; independent scope reviewer checks the record against current headers and ADRs.
obligations.acceptance: The preflight has unresolved_semantic_decisions=[], authority_conflict=false, verification_conflict=false, package_scope_conflict=false, and maps every S1-S3 obligation to an oracle.

obligations.requirement: Source loss/unregister delivers a keyed Cancel to the real Session owner and does not cancel another source sharing the same pointerId.
obligations.oracle: Counting SessionOwner adapter receives normalized Cancel for source A; source B remains live; unregister and sourceLost are both exercised; old-generation events are submitted after cancel.
obligations.acceptance: RED on the untouched baseline because RuntimeAppBinding discards sourceLost output and unregister has no cancellation delivery; GREEN has exactly one keyed Cancel, B alive, no canonical commit, and next Down starts a fresh generation.

obligations.requirement: PointerKey identity and late-generation fencing remain intact through InputRouter, CreationSession, BrushSession, selection, pan and eraser paths.
obligations.oracle: Two-source same-pointer schedule plus late Move/Up/Cancel and next Down; compare owner session ledger, canonical operation count and per-source traces.
obligations.acceptance: No cross-source cancellation, no duplicate/ghost operation, stale generation rejected, and valid next gesture accepted.

obligations.requirement: Runtime coordinates dirty/stale/retry and keeps Preview alive until matching Canonical handoff; resize/rebind/loss/close invalidate old captures.
obligations.oracle: Immutable frame/preview capture schedule with busy/retry, matching and mismatched document/surface/metrics generations, resize, loss, rebind and close; inspect visible-role and retirement state.
obligations.acceptance: No flashback to old canonical, stale capture never presents, preview retires only after qualified matching canonical visibility, close leaves no pending task or borrowed owner pointer.

obligations.requirement: Frame requests use real logical/physical size, DPR and metrics generation; Canonical and Preview lifecycle remain independent.
obligations.oracle: Non-1 DPR metrics update and independent canonical/preview loss/restored schedule; verify FrameState, SurfaceSnapshot and provider calls.
obligations.acceptance: Coordinate conversion uses supplied metrics exactly, roles do not cross-invalidate, and no fixed DPR=1 or stale target is emitted.

obligations.requirement: Accepted/flush/fence feedback is not reported as physical Presented without qualifying platform evidence.
obligations.oracle: PresentationTracker and CanonicalHandoffEvaluator schedule accepted, approximate and platform-qualified feedback, including duplicate/conflict/stale generation cases.
obligations.acceptance: Only matching platform-qualified feedback enables the contractually eligible handoff; unknown/approximate evidence remains visible and non-qualified.

obligations.requirement: Control requests retain their original target and context fence through queueing and owner-safe-point application.
obligations.oracle: Queue request against target A, switch selection to B, then process; delete/restore/rebind/session/permission/resource invalidation schedules are exercised.
obligations.acceptance: A is modified only when its fence is valid; B is never accidentally modified; stale/expired/invalidated receipts are explicit.

obligations.requirement: Primary-only and selection-set intent remain distinct; a leaf strokeWidth edit preserves each target's other canonical style fields.
obligations.oracle: Two selected objects with different color/cap/join/dash receive a width-only patch and a primary-only command; compare before/after canonical records and operation payload.
obligations.acceptance: Exactly one existing operation per accepted edit, all non-target style leaves preserved, no compound draft overwrites remote color changes, Clear reset remains unimplemented/open.

obligations.requirement: Control snapshot/readback reports real availability, writable, busy, permission, resource, revision, receipt and confirmed values; it does not hard-code PASS.
obligations.oracle: Counting/fake owner drives unavailable, busy, locked, stale, applied and failed states through the binding; compare snapshot and receipt to owner state.
obligations.acceptance: RED on the untouched baseline because CanvasControlBinding hard-codes targetAvailable/writable/busy; GREEN mirrors owner truth and separates pending draft from confirmed Runtime values.

obligations.requirement: Two independent Runtime/View instances do not share input, session, frame, control, preview or canonical state.
obligations.oracle: Run identical and interleaved source/frame/control schedules against two instances and compare instance-local ledgers, surface generations and snapshots.
obligations.acceptance: No cross-instance event, generation, receipt or presentation state is observed.

obligations.requirement: Only the authorized runtime/host/test/evidence paths change, and FC-01 worktree and historical controls remain untouched.
obligations.oracle: Exact diff from 201cc8841a0e6de4cd4b8a3dfc6c337820d35704, protected-path audit, git diff --check, and comparison of FC-01 worktree/status before and after.
obligations.acceptance: No product feature expansion, public ABI rewrite, package-input mutation, FC-01/PX0/G4 result mutation, or unauthorized path; clean diff check.
